'''Alamindra Cutren''' is a member of the [[Council of Merchants]], [[Arad Doman]]'s governing body.  

== Activities ==
She is found hiding in her cousin's lands and taken captive by the [[Aiel]].{{ref/book|13|31}} 

Before leaving [[Arad Doman]], [[Rand al'Thor]] ordered [[Davram Bashere]] and [[Rhuarc]] to return Alamindra and the rest of the Council to their palaces.{{ref/book|13|42}}
